items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: I asked for ... Steve Barrios ... So now I’ve got a band with the Brecker brothers, four of the greatest percussionists in the world

ctx.x: So I got — I asked for Mike Brecker, Randy Brecker, and three of the greatest percussionists, who I feel, in the world, because they have knowledge of the folklorico stuff and the contemporary stuff — Giovanni Hidalgo, Steve Barrios and Alex Acuna. I wanted Danilo Perez on piano but for some reason he couldn’t make it so Gil Goldstein showed up. Carlos Benevent, who is the bass player for Paco DeLucia, the flamenco guitar player, and Mitch Stein on guitar, who was a friend of mine who I’d met playing with Tania…

And you can hear, like my rapport, I’m so excited. I was screaming and jumping up and down, I was so excited, I couldn’t come down and I couldn’t even talk. I have to remember that I’m supposed to also be an emcee for this thing. And I was saying stuff like “I’m in heaven, I’ve died, I’m going to heaven.” I just couldn’t help it. And those…
